title: Chapter 002
synopsis: WiraMadha arrives at the city and forms a party with various characters to tackle a dungeon, facing a giant monster and strategizing to overcome challenges while developing relationships.

scenes.title: Dungeon Preparation
scenes.summary: WiraMadha and party members prepare for a dungeon encounter, introducing themselves and strategizing.
scenes.text: WiraMadha enters the dungeon lobby, meeting HoppyLite, DrakeCloud, and Sylvia, discussing strategies and forming a team.

events.summary: WiraMadha prepares for the dungeon, meeting fellow players and discussing the quest ahead.

scenes.title: Dungeon Encounter
scenes.summary: The party battles the giant Agni Centipede, strategizing to defeat it while using their abilities.
scenes.text: A fierce battle against the Kelabang Agni ensues with teamwork, special abilities, and quick thinking.

events.summary: The team battles the Agni Centipede, using their skills effectively to survive and defeat the monster.
After defeating the boss, WiraMadha and Sylvia discuss their next steps and agree to team up for future quests.
